mission.title: Digital Disturbance
mission.description: Recover a stolen computer virus and put a small bomb in its place.

phase.briefing:
The Machines stole a computer virus of ours last night and it must be returned. We need the computer virus recovered and a bomb put in its place as a friendly reminder that taking what is ours will not be tolerated.
Go to this location and pick up the bomb from Philippa. When you have the bomb, I will send you the targeted location for the bomb and where the virus will be recovered.

objective.text: Pick up the bomb from Philippa

phase.briefing: I'm sending you to the Machine base now. Once you've reached the place, I'll be able to run a scan of the area and provide some more information.

enter.say: The area is swarming with Machines so be on the lookout. Oh, it might also be worth mentioning that I think they have a security system in place.

objective.text: Plant the bomb on the computer that has the computer virus

phase.briefing: I'll sending you the drop-off point for the virus. Don't delay.

enter.say: Cornelius will take the computer virus for you.

objective.text: Deliver the computer virus to Cornelius
